label: fed-back "o" in copy phase (o at original position >= 2, not last step)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost exclusively (99.8% of mass) when the fed-back input token is "o", i.e. right after the model has re-emitted an original "o". It requires that "o" to come from original position 2 or later (recall_idx >= 3); it never fires on o at original positions 0-1, never in the original or delimiter phase, and is weak or absent on the final output step. Magnitude is largest when the o was at original position 2-3 (t around 10-13, e.g. "j h o w ... <DEL> j h [o]"), and falls off for later positions and when few outputs remain (to_go 0-1). It is token-specific: other letters and digits almost never activate it. Remaining false positives are mostly o fed back late in the copy with only 1 output left.

issues: The label's 'o at original position >= 2' overclaims. Dev precision grid for in_tok==o in the copy phase with to_go>=1: recall_idx 3 gives 0.82-0.995 and recall_idx 4 gives 0.86-0.999, but recall_idx 5 gives only 0.50-0.77, recall_idx 6 gives 0.15-0.25 and recall_idx 7 gives 0.15. An 'o' from original position 5 or later mostly does not fire (dev score for recall_idx>=6: precision 0.13, recall 0.065). Those late-position 'o' steps are a systematic class of false positives.

The explanation blames most false positives on an 'o' fed back late with only 1 output left. That is only part of it. Test misses show false positives like 'b i b l n 2 o z 0 <DEL> b i b l n 2 *o* z' (t=16, recall_idx 7). These are late original positions and are not limited to to_go==1.

The explanation's own numbers point to the fix: capping recall_idx at 3..5 helps. Combining that cap with to_go>=1 gives dev F1 0.875 against 0.817 for the original predicate. That suggests the upper limit belongs in the label.

Claims that hold up: the feature fires only in the copy phase (100% of mass), 99.8% of mass is on in_tok o, it never fires for recall_idx<=2 (0.02% of mass), to_go==0 is weak (precision about 0.1-0.2), and magnitude peaks at t 10-13 and recall_idx 3-4.
skeptic.revised_label: fed-back "o" in copy phase that came from original position 2-4 (strongest at 2-3), not on the final step

final_label: fed-back "o" in copy phase that came from original position 2-4 (strongest at 2-3), not on the final step
